name: ExpertWitnessManager
tagline: Source, vet, engage and manage expert witnesses – conflict checks, disclosure deadlines, admissibility challenges and fee caps in one app.
description: A complete expert-evidence workflow for litigation and arbitration teams in one PCF control: candidate shortlists with a configurable vetting checklist and side-by-side comparison, conflict checks, engagement terms with hourly rate and approved fee cap, letters of instruction, draft-report and court-ordered disclosure deadlines with a buffer rule, reply reports and testimony dates, admissibility challenges that block testimony when upheld, consulting (non-disclosed) experts that can never be served by mistake, invoices, payments and cap increases with client approval. Works in Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages, with fictional demo data out of the box.
features: Vetting checklist and candidate comparison per matter and discipline
Conflict check clear / conflict found with reference and date
Engagement rules: vetting, cleared conflict, signed letter, rate and fee cap
Draft due at least N days before the disclosure deadline; overdue and due-soon alerts
Testifying vs consulting experts – non-disclosed experts cannot be served
Admissibility challenges (threatened, filed, rejected, upheld) – upheld blocks testimony
Invoices blocked over the cap, payments, cap increases with client approval
Bulk assign lead lawyer, decline candidates, CSV export, undo
Phone layouts from 320 px, keyboard and ARIA support
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.ExpertWitnessManager data-set; niray_Niray.ExpertWitnessManagerPortal field control)
